divergences.why: INITIALIZE is dropped with the sub-command: no caches
LIST's developer line needs developer mode, which the original has only on the developers' registration numbers; silvermere's DEBUG grant stands for it (docs/differences.md)
CONFIGURE SHOW's three credit lines are not shown in silvermere: no BBS credits (docs/differences.md)
CONFIGURE SHOW's developer pair needs developer mode, which the original has only on the developers' registration numbers; silvermere's DEBUG grant stands for it (docs/differences.md)
the MajorMUD Sysop menu's U (the importer CLI), B and E (the kernel's editors) and A (licensing) lines are not shown in silvermere (docs/differences.md, the sysop menu rows)
unknown_lines: ^\s*(?:U - Apply an update|B - Edit the sysop bulletin file|E - Edit the wccmmud\.ini file \(only if it is small\)|A - Addon module activation codes)\s*$
